nodes.description: Public address state variable holding the contract owner, set to msg.sender in the constructor.
IBancorChanger state variable, external changer contract used for ETH<->smart token conversions.
IEtherToken state variable, external wrapped-ETH token contract.
ERC20 state variable referencing the BNT token contract.
ISmartToken state variable, the Bancor smart token obtained from tokenChanger.token().
Public mapping(address => uint256) intended to track user positions.
Constructor: sets owner to msg.sender and initializes tokenChanger, etherToken, bnt and smartToken.
Payable function: deposits ETH, approves the changer, performs the change and transfers smart tokens to msg.sender.
Owner-only function that calls selfdestruct(owner).
Constant helper returning the expected amount for buying smart tokens with etherToken.
Constant helper returning the expected amount for selling smart tokens for etherToken.
Constant helper forwarding getReturn to the token changer with arbitrary tokens.
Closes a long position by changing the caller's BNT balance back into etherToken.
Unrestricted function performing a token change with a hardcoded amount.
Constant function returning the changer return for the caller's BNT balance.
Public function calling etherToken.withdraw with a caller-supplied amount.
Constant helper returning etherToken balance of an address.
Constant helper returning BNT balance of an address.
Empty public function stub documented as callable by anybody.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, token transfers and balance lookups.
Block timestamp; not used in this contract.
Transaction origin; not used in this contract.
External payable call depositing msg.value ETH into the ether token contract.
External call granting the changer an allowance over msg.value ether tokens.
External call into the Bancor changer with a minimum return of 1 (no slippage protection).
External token transfer sending purchased smart tokens to msg.sender.
Destroys the contract and sends its entire balance to owner.
External change in closeLong using the caller's BNT balance with minimum return 1.
External call withdrawing ether from the ether token contract for an arbitrary caller-supplied amount.
Unrestricted external change executed in moo() with a hardcoded amount.
External balance query against the ether token contract.
External balance query against the BNT token contract.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner from msg.sender.
Constructor initializes tokenChanger state variable.
Constructor initializes etherToken state variable.
Constructor initializes bnt state variable.
Constructor sets smartToken from tokenChanger.token().
smartToken derives from tokenChanger.token().
long() executes etherToken.deposit with msg.value.
long() approves the changer to spend the deposited ether tokens.
long() invokes tokenChanger.change to buy smart tokens.
long() performs an external token transfer to msg.sender after external calls with weak return handling.
External deposit call happens before the state-affecting change call, exposing reentrancy surface.
Approval created before change enables the changer to pull ether tokens.
Return value of the external change() is used to transfer tokens to the caller.
msg.sender is the recipient of the token transfer in long().
Local smartToken variable is passed into tokenChanger.change.
long() reads tokenChanger.token() into the local smartToken variable.
long() stores the change result in the local returnAmount variable.
change() return value is assigned to returnAmount.
long() credits msg.sender with the purchased tokens.
release() calls selfdestruct(owner).
release() gates execution on a check between msg.sender and owner.
owner state variable is compared against msg.sender in release().
selfdestruct sends the contract balance to the owner address.
closeLong() calls tokenChanger.change to sell the caller's tokens.
closeLong() uses getBNTBalance(msg.sender) as the amount to change.
getBNTBalance is queried with msg.sender.
moo() calls tokenChanger.change with a hardcoded amount.
moo() uses the tokenChanger state variable for the change.
smartToken state variable is an argument of the change in moo().
withdraw() calls etherToken.withdraw.
Caller-supplied returnAmount parameter is passed directly into etherToken.withdraw.
getETHBalance calls etherToken.balanceOf.
Address parameter a is used in the etherToken balance query.
getBNTBalance calls bnt.balanceOf.
Address parameter a is used in the BNT balance query.
bnt state variable is the target of balanceOf.
etherToken state variable is the target of balanceOf.
etherToken state variable receives the ETH deposit.
etherToken state variable is the token being approved.
smartToken is passed as the destination token in change().
tokenChanger state variable is the external contract invoked in long().
getReturn() calls getBNTBalance(msg.sender).
getReturn() uses msg.sender to fetch the caller's BNT balance.
Parameter _amount is consumed by getBuyReturn.
Parameter _amount is consumed by getSellReturn.
Parameter _fromToken is forwarded by getReturn.
Parameter _toToken is forwarded by getReturn.
Parameter _amount is forwarded by getReturn.
